title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode5 Sheet Music From The Past

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Sheet Music From The Past
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This sheet music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think it's for the piano.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks hard.
I don't think I have enough fingers for this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's this song called?
Let's see... The title says...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Fantaisie-Impromptu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is sheet music for Chopin's Fantaisie-Impromptu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
You can tell just by glancing at it?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, um... Another piece may not have been so obvious, but this one...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I practiced playing it so much when I was little.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That means...
This sheet music might also have come from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
You're likely right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This really takes me back...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I remember spending every single day sitting at the piano.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite the fatigue, I had to keep my fingers moving... My vision even went blurry from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Things were so hard.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So hard that I found myself hating music itself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm able to keep moving forward today because of what I experienced back then.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That also applies to the task Ken gave me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My task...
That's it, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About the task you helped me the other day with... I think I know what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should be able to produce some results now, so I hope you'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're willing to say that, Toya, then I think there's nothing for me to worry about!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it is a bit unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh?
What is?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How you've got such a good head on your shoulders!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why is it unfortunate that I have a good head on my shoulders?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because I don't have anything to do now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was hoping to help you all since you've been working so hard on your tasks, but it seems that I don't have anything to teach you, Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once again, you found the solution all on your own!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I...see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, I wish you'd lean on me more since I'm here in the first place to help you make your dreams a reality!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've already helped me so much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What...?!
I... I have?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whether it's making me laugh whenever something is bothering me, or inviting me to have a nice meal with you and MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your kindness has always allowed me to take a step back and relax...and given me a chance to think about how to tackle my problems.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, KAITO, thank you for everything you've done for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha!
Wow, now I'm the one receiving all the encouragement!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad to hear that I've been able to help you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You have.
And I'll be asking you for more help in the future.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll do everything I can to make sure you're all able to go beyond that giant wall!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
With that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I promise to surpass RAD WEEKEND!
And—
se_event_breakdown_2024_002

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
Did you hear that sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it seemed like it came from over by the wall...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
KAITO, there's a crack in it...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
Wow, and a fairly big one too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But why now...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(This wall...
It must have something to do with how we see RAD WEEKEND in our minds...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah...
Maybe that's it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is just my hunch...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I think our desire to overcome the obstacle in front of us—to see what's beyond—is what caused this crack to form in the wall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
So when you do find a way to overcome it, then maybe it'll crumble to pieces!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe. You may be right.
In any case...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to see what's beyond it as soon as I can.
